title: SRD: recover remaining swallowed subclass features (When you join / When you take this oath; Warlock Pact Magic)
description:
Follow-up from eshyra-0m9.13 (feature boundary parsing). The named swallowed cases are fixed, but verification surfaced residual swallowed features whose grant lead-ins are still unrecognized, plus one un-split spellcasting feature. None are introduced by 0m9.13 — they are pre-existing gaps the now-complete feature bodies revealed.

Remaining gaps (generated pack evidence):
1. feature:college-of-lore:bonus-proficiencies (3rd level) is still swallowed into the College of Lore subclass description. Lead-in 'When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level' is not in parseFeatures LEVEL_LEAD_IN. There is exactly ONE 'When you join' occurrence in the pack, so adding it cleanly completes College of Lore (2->... currently 3 with Cutting Words -> 4). No protected-test collision.
2. feature:oath-of-devotion:channel-divinity (3rd level) is swallowed into subclass:oath-of-devotion's description. Lead-in 'When you take this oath at 3rd level' is unrecognized. CAUTION: emitting it changes oath-of-devotion's feature count (3->4) and would alter the protected Oath of Devotion description/body design and its enshrined tests (srdGeneratedPack 'keeps the exact reviewed feature count' = 3, and the oath projection test). Per the 0m9.13 phase rules this needs an explicit design decision before changing.
3. feature:warlock:pact-magic is NOT a separate record in committed OR generated (pre-existing) — Pact Magic is swallowed into feature:warlock:otherworldly-patron even though the warlock progression table lists 'Otherworldly Patron, Pact Magic' as two level-1 features. This also produces the lone remaining auditSrdStructure swallowed-feature-heading finding: 'otherworldly-patron -> Higher', which is actually an AUDIT FALSE POSITIVE on the legitimate spellcasting sub-heading 'Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher' (now present because the 0m9.13 extractor fix correctly completed the Pact Magic body). Splitting Pact Magic would not silence that finding; the audit HEADING_GRANT_PAIR heuristic should also be refined to ignore '… Level and Higher At …' sub-headings.

Suggested work:
- Add 'When you join' (and, with a design decision, 'When you take this oath') to LEVEL_LEAD_IN; add focused parseFeatures tests; regen + verify; update subclass counts (college-of-lore 3->4; oath-of-devotion 3->4 only if the oath design change is approved).
- Investigate why 'Pact Magic' (which HAS a level-1 table anchor) is not split from Otherworldly Patron; emit it as feature:warlock:pact-magic.
- Refine srdAudit HEADING_GRANT_PAIR to not flag the 'Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher' spellcasting sub-heading.

Files: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.ts, src/rules/srdAudit.ts, test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.test.ts, test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts.
